detail.longDescription: How is the api server supposed to reach clusterip webhooks with native routing? Reaching the webhook from another pod in-cluster works fine. Presumably the control node's host networking source IP doesn't trip the eBPF NAT, I can see the packets landing on the default gateway, rather than heading to a backing pod IP. # Cilium # CiliumCNI # Kubernetes # k8s # K8sathome
